outcome.descriptive: A bug whose files are all test files now becomes a regression task when its fix is planned; any other bug stays tdd.
outcome.technical: audit-task.py add --bug <bugId>: _bug_fix_discipline(bug) picks regression with a note when every file the bug names is a test path (_filed_returns.is_test_path), tdd otherwise (including a bug naming no file); applied only when --tests-mode is absent; the same write sets bug.taskId and status in_progress. Cases bf1-bf7 (bf-block). bug.md step 3, verbs-in-full --bug section, task.md hint. test_audit_task 924/924, test__refs 334/334.
